stemMd: What is the minimum value of x squared minus 6x plus 14 for real x?
explanationMd: Complete the square: x squared−6x+14=(x−3) squared+5. A real square is nonnegative, so the minimum is 5, attained at x=3.

distractorRationale.a: This is the value at x=0.
distractorRationale.c: This is the x-coordinate of the minimum.
distractorRationale.b: This omits the constant remaining after completing the square.
